title: Austin: Fine Remitted, Park Plans Funded
summary:
*   The city remitted a $46.10 court fine and associated costs for Willie Childress.
*   $75 was approved to fund plans and specifications for "the parking of North East Avenue," likely referring to landscaping or urban beautification.
*   This park beautification project had received prior approval from a "Citizens Committee," highlighting early community involvement in urban planning.

015
Regular meeting of the City Council; Austin, Texas, Sept 25th 1913: The Council was called
to order by the Mayor :Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, & Haynes 4
Absent excused Councilman Powell 1
The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meetings were read and adopted:
The Mayor laid before the Council the reports of the Supt of the Water & Light Plant& that
of the Fire Marshal, which were read and ordered filed: The Council then recessed subject
to call :

Sept 27th 1913, the Council was called to order by the Mayor with allpresent except
Councilman Powell.
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Upon good and sufficient reasons
unto the City Council shown , Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin :
Fine Willie
Childress
remitted ✓ That the balance of the fine and costs in the case of the State of Texasvs
Willie Childress, cause No 7975, in the Corporation Court of the City of Austin, Texas,
which balance amounts to the sum of $ 46.10,be and the same is hereby remitted.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony,Bartholomew & Haynes 4
Absent Councilman Powell 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : Rice Fred
Andrawartha
Services Parks ✓ That the sum of seventy five ($ 75.00) dollars be and the same is hereby
appropriated out of the Miscellaneous Park Fund set apart for the improvement of North
East Avenue ,in payment of a bill for services rendered by Jno Andrawartha to the Citizens
Committee and approved by said Citizens Committee and former Councilman Jas P Hart, for
plans and specifications accepted by said Committee and through said Committee by the City
of Austin, for the parking of North East Avenue.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew & Haynes 4
Absent Councilman Powell 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
The Council then adjourned.

Jno Johnson
City Clerk.
